newsitem.title: USA: Recycling sees Q1 revs $10.5 mln.
newsitem.headline: Recycling sees Q1 revs $10.5 mln.

text.p: Recycling Industries Inc said on Wednesday that it expects revenues of $10.5 million for 1997 fiscal first quarter, ended December 31, 1996, an increase over 1996 fiscal first quarter 1995.
The company expects a quarterly operating profit for its seven recycling facilities. A net loss, however, is expected for the quarter which is attributable to acquisition and integration expenses.
The results are expected to be better than analyst estimates of a few hundred thousand dollar loss for the quarter, it said.
